description.value: Pho Japolo is a proudly family-run Vietnamese and Japanese fusion restaurant in business since 1995, now with four locations across Metro Vancouver. The North Vancouver spot on Marine Drive serves classic pho in multiple configurations alongside inventive sushi creations like sushi pizza and sushi burgers that have made it a long-standing neighbourhood favourite. Generous portions and a welcoming, homey atmosphere make it a solid stop for a substantial meal after a ride.

address.value: 2070 Marine Drive, North Vancouver, BC V7P 1V7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as 'Japolo' at unit 218H in North Vancouver, tagged as a Vietnamese/Japanese/sushi restaurant. The website confirms the brand is 'Pho Japolo,' a four-location family-run chain operating since 1995; the North Vancouver location is at 2070 Marine Drive with phone (604) 985-3993. Takeout is confirmed by 'Order Online' links for the North Vancouver location and a menu note that 'for take-out, only large available.' No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
